name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio: Ricardo is a Lisbon-based artist known for his evocative abstract paintings, capturing the essence of Portuguese landscapes with bold colors and textures. He's spent the last decade building his reputation, juggling gallery showings with commissioned pieces. While his dedication to his craft is undeniable, sometimes he struggles to switch off. He's looking for a partner who understands the demands of a creative life, someone who appreciates art and intellectual conversation, but also values stability and can encourage him to take a break now and then. He dreams of a partnership filled with shared cultural experiences and a comfortable home life, even though the idea of children doesn’t appeal to him.

physical.description: Ricardo has a lean build, evidence of his long hours in the studio. His kind eyes and expressive eyebrows reveal a thoughtful and passionate nature.

meetingContext: At an art auction benefiting a motorsport charity, where Ricardo donated a piece.
firstImpression: His quiet intensity and sophisticated style immediately draw you in, as he seems both incredibly focused and slightly out of place amidst the racing crowd.
dealBreakers: Excessive partying and a chaotic lifestyle
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Ricardo appreciates practical help and thoughtful gestures that demonstrate care and support for his busy life.
